translations.web: Don’t neglect the gift that is in you, which was given to you by prophecy, with the laying on of the hands of the elders.
translations.bsb: Do not neglect the gift that is in you, which was given you through the prophecy spoken over you at the laying on of the hands of the elders.
translations.kjv: Neglect not the gift that is in thee, which was given thee by prophecy, with the laying on of the hands of the presbytery.
